# DCO remediation

Every commit on `main` up to and including `1368abd2f7102971a68336d69acddedef80bb075` (the cutoff) predates the DCO. So does the first commit of the pull request that introduced it, `8a82ced`. The maintainer remediated all 47 of them with an individual remediation commit, in the format the [DCO GitHub App](https://github.com/apps/dco) accepts (`.github/dco.yml` allows it). The commit is titled "DCO remediation for commits before the DCO cutoff". Every line of its message reads:

```text
I, Ronan Flynn-Curran <dev@ronan.design>, hereby add my Signed-off-by to this commit: <sha>
```
